remarks: CHARMING, EXPANDED CAPE - LARGER THAN IT LOOKS! Situated on one of the loveliest cul-de-sacs in the historic Bettswood neighborhood, this picture-perfect home blends character details like crown molding, curved archways, and hardwood floors with new features like hydronic radiant heat flooring, spacious closets, 2-car garage, and zoned C/A. From the storybook entry, the LR with fireplace opens to the DR, and flows into the impressive cook's Kitchen. This amazing space checks all the boxes: an over-sized island for gatherings, honed granite counters, stainless steel appliances, and a pantry. The OPEN CONCEPT extends into the Great Room with 9' ceilings, transom windows, and fireplace. French doors lead to the expansive deck perfect for entertaining, overlooking a flat, partially fenced yard. Extend your outdoor enjoyment in the screened porch - an idyllic setting for morning coffee or rainy weekends. Upstairs find a private and spacious Primary Suite with vaulted ceilings, sitting area, and TWO WALK-IN CLOSETS. Melt your cares away in the adjoining Primary Bath with a glass-enclosed STEAM SHOWER, rain-head shower, and heated floor. Enjoy the convenience of the washer/dryer plus additional closet space in hallway. Two other BRs offer window seats for storage, walk-in closets, and share a hall Bath with deep soaker tub/shower. Located in a vibrant, VERY WALKABLE area close to restaurants, bars, shopping. ** Multiple offers, asking for HIGHEST/BEST by 5pm, MONDAY 8/12/24 **
